limits: 180 seconds of predeclared coverage per TV is controller qualification, not 24-hour endurance or long-duration memory stability.
Native guardian and worker identities from the production receipt were present, valid and error-free in every one of the 240 resource rows per TV. Sampling remains periodic and mapping detail sparse.

The controller is adapter-driven. Device/firmware/signing/process checks, durable intents, hash-verified downloads and owned cleanup remain the adapter responsibility; scheduler completion alone does not prove continuity.
A full endurance invocation still needs supervised host execution, free-space monitoring, a 24-hour job and an appropriate mixed work/idle schedule. Standby/reboot is not authorized.

Managed acquisition entry, worker fallback and the independent 300-second .NET SDK rescue remain deployed. No package update, power transition, global policy, persistent file capability or SMACK change occurred.
